events.title: The Red Chair Bookshop 3-Day Used Book Sale
events.description: The Red Chair Bookshop 3-Day Used Book Sale The Red Chair Bookshop 3-Day Used Book Sale Returns to Park View! The Denver Public Library Friends Foundation is thrilled to announce the return of our beloved Central Library Used Book Sale ! Don’t miss this chance to browse thousands of gently loved books, CDs, DVDs, and more at unbeatable prices. Event Details 📍 Location: Park View at the Denver Central Library 📅 Dates: Friday, November 13 : 10 a.m.–4:30 p.m. Saturday, November 14 : 11 a.m.–4:30 p.m. Sunday, November 15 : 11 a.m.–3 p.m. ($15 Bag Sale!) 🛍️ Bring Your Own Tote Bag! We encourage all shoppers to bring their own bags to carry their treasures. Special Opportunities Bag Sale: Fill a tote bag with books for one low price. Volunteer with Us: Help make this event a success! Contact Andrea ahamilton@denverlibrary.org Corporate Teams: Interested in volunteering as a group? Contact Liz at lguillebaud@denverlibrary.org to schedule your shift. Proceeds from the sale directly support the Denver Public Library Friends Foundation, helping fund the programs and services that make our library a cornerstone of our community. Red Chair Bookshop will be closed during the sale. Head across Schlessman Hall to the Park View space to shop our inventory at the mega sale! 📚 Mark your calendar and join us for this exciting celebration of books and community! Have questions? Please contact Andrea Hamilton, Manager of Philanthropy—Used Book Sales ahamilton@denverlibrary.org .

events.title: The Emotional Lives of Parents with Dr. Lisa Damour
events.description: Author Talk with Lisa Damour 📅 Date & Time: February 17, 2027 6-8pm 📍 Location: Park View, Central Library Join us for an inspiring evening with Lisa Damour, Ph.D. , a renowned psychologist and bestselling author known for her invaluable insights into adolescent development and mental health. This talk will focus on the emotional lives of parents, unpacking the feelings parents rarely discuss. Event Schedule: Exclusive VIP Reception 🕑 6:00 PM – 7:00 PM VIP guests will be invited to join Dr. Damour for an exclusive cocktail reception with light bites starting at 6pm. Each guest will receive a signed copy of her new book. 🕑 7:00 PM – Author Talk Dr. Damour will deliver a 45-minute presentation , offering expert guidance on supporting parents’ emotional lives: unpacking the feelings parents rarely discuss. ❓ 7:45 PM – Q&A Session Engage directly with Dr. Damour during a 15-minute Q&A , where she will answer audience questions. 🎟️ Author Talk tickets are free and open to all—registration required. 🎟️ $150 VIP tickets are limited—secure yours today! Don’t miss this chance to gain expert insights from Lisa Damour and support the Denver Public Library Friends Foundation. Reserve your spot today! Dr. Lisa Damour is the author of three New York Times best sellers: Untangled, Under Pressure, and The Emotional Lives of Teenagers, which have been translated into twenty-three languages. Her forthcoming book, The Emotional Lives of Parents, publishes on February 9, 2027 and is available for pre-order now. Dr. Damour hosts the Ask Lisa podcast, works in collaboration with UNICEF, and is recognized as a thought leader by the American Psychological Association. She authored the monthly Adolescence column for The New York Times, is a regular contributor to national news outlets, and created Untangling 10to20, a digital library of premium content to support teens and those who care for them. Dr. Damour serves as a Senior Advisor to the Schubert Center for Child Studies at Case Western Reserve University and has written numerous academic papers, chapters, and books related to education and child development. She maintains a clinical practice and also speaks to schools, professional organizations, and corporate groups around the world on the topics of child and adolescent development, family mental health, and adult well-being. Dr. Damour also works with industry leaders on topics related to adolescent mental health and was a consultant to Pixar on the film Inside Out 2. Dr. Damour graduated with honors from Yale University and worked for the Yale Child Study Center before earning her doctorate in Clinical Psychology at the University of Michigan. She and her husband are the proud parents of two daughters. Sponsorship opportunities are available. For questions, please contact Liz Guillebaud at lguillebaud@denverlibrary.org or 516.662.2591
